title: A Retrospective Register Study to Map the Frequency of Short Duration Atrial Fibrillation (AF) Among All Patients Admitted to Roskilde Sygehus in Denmark in 2010
brief_summary: Retrospective observational study of patients with atrial fibrillation admitted to Roskilde University Hospital in 2010.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Atrial fibrillation

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: All patients admitted and discharged with a diagnose of atrial fibrillation in 2010 at Roskilde University Hospital
